nodes.label: Rationale: use globe.gl (three.js wrapper) for a photorealistic Earth on a dark starfield, chosen because it natively provides camera fly-to and multi-point framing plus real satellite textures
nodes.norm_label: rationale: use globe.gl (three.js wrapper) for a photorealistic earth on a dark starfield, chosen because it natively provides camera fly-to and multi-point framing plus real satellite textures

nodes.label: Rationale: BRICS+UK groups 6 non-contiguous countries so the camera must frame a wide bounds view of all 6 markers at once, never a single-point zoom or sequential fly-by
nodes.norm_label: rationale: brics+uk groups 6 non-contiguous countries so the camera must frame a wide bounds view of all 6 markers at once, never a single-point zoom or sequential fly-by

nodes.label: Fixed-order region cycle: Asie → BRICS+UK → Europe → Amérique du Nord → (retour à Asie), driven by nextRegionId/prevRegionId/regionPosition
nodes.norm_label: fixed-order region cycle: asie → brics+uk → europe → amerique du nord → (retour a asie), driven by nextregionid/prevregionid/regionposition

nodes.label: Camera framing geometry: haversine distance + centroid used to compute a single-point vs bounds point-of-view for globe.gl
nodes.norm_label: camera framing geometry: haversine distance + centroid used to compute a single-point vs bounds point-of-view for globe.gl

nodes.label: Region label normalization: free-text Firestore group/region labels (accent/case-insensitive substring match) mapped to the globe's 4 canonical region ids
nodes.norm_label: region label normalization: free-text firestore group/region labels (accent/case-insensitive substring match) mapped to the globe's 4 canonical region ids

nodes.label: Rationale: market indices chosen as the first editable section because they are the smallest, most self-contained data shape, proving the Firestore write path end-to-end before riskier sections since every plan writes to the live production database
nodes.norm_label: rationale: market indices chosen as the first editable section because they are the smallest, most self-contained data shape, proving the firestore write path end-to-end before riskier sections since every plan writes to the live production database

nodes.label: Optimistic-update-with-rollback-on-failure pattern: update in-memory db and re-render immediately, write to Firestore in background, revert and toast on failure — reused by indices, companies, portfolio, news, weeks and IA & Fintech edit handlers
nodes.norm_label: optimistic-update-with-rollback-on-failure pattern: update in-memory db and re-render immediately, write to firestore in background, revert and toast on failure — reused by indices, companies, portfolio, news, weeks and ia & fintech edit handlers

nodes.label: Rationale: split admin/edit UI one data section per plan (indices, companies, portfolio, news, weeks, IA & Fintech) rather than one large edit-mode plan, since every write targets the same live production Firestore database used weekly by interns
nodes.norm_label: rationale: split admin/edit ui one data section per plan (indices, companies, portfolio, news, weeks, ia & fintech) rather than one large edit-mode plan, since every write targets the same live production firestore database used weekly by interns

nodes.label: Injectable-dependency testing pattern: fetch/html2pdf/writeFn/setInterval passed as overridable parameters (defaulting to the real implementation) so I/O-heavy code stays unit-testable — reused across firestoreClient, quoteClient, portfolioLiveRefresh and pdfExport
nodes.norm_label: injectable-dependency testing pattern: fetch/html2pdf/writefn/setinterval passed as overridable parameters (defaulting to the real implementation) so i/o-heavy code stays unit-testable — reused across firestoreclient, quoteclient, portfolioliverefresh and pdfexport

nodes.label: Rationale: extract buildEditableInput from sidePanel.js's local helper into admin/editableInput.js once companies need the same text/number input-swap pattern indices already used — removing real duplication, not speculative abstraction
nodes.norm_label: rationale: extract buildeditableinput from sidepanel.js's local helper into admin/editableinput.js once companies need the same text/number input-swap pattern indices already used — removing real duplication, not speculative abstraction

nodes.label: Rationale: extract ddmmToISOThisYear into data/dateUtils.js so companyChart.js and the new portfolio-live-refresh feature don't duplicate the same DD/MM-to-ISO regex twice
nodes.norm_label: rationale: extract ddmmtoisothisyear into data/dateutils.js so companychart.js and the new portfolio-live-refresh feature don't duplicate the same dd/mm-to-iso regex twice

nodes.label: Portfolio region ids differ from the globe's canonical region ids (asie, brics-uk, europe, amerique-du-nord-canada) and must be translated via PORTFOLIO_REGION_BY_GLOBE_REGION, returning empty results rather than throwing for unmapped ids
nodes.norm_label: portfolio region ids differ from the globe's canonical region ids (asie, brics-uk, europe, amerique-du-nord-canada) and must be translated via portfolio_region_by_globe_region, returning empty results rather than throwing for unmapped ids

nodes.label: Rationale: use Firestore writeBatch for cascading week deletion (20-30 documents across indices/news/companies × 4 regions) instead of sequential per-document deletes, so failure semantics are simply all-or-nothing rather than an unknown half-deleted state
nodes.norm_label: rationale: use firestore writebatch for cascading week deletion (20-30 documents across indices/news/companies × 4 regions) instead of sequential per-document deletes, so failure semantics are simply all-or-nothing rather than an unknown half-deleted state

nodes.label: Rationale: deleting an entire week's curated content warrants a window.confirm() gate naming the week and document count — the first deliberate exception to this feature's established act-immediately-rely-on-rollback pattern, given the blast radius
nodes.norm_label: rationale: deleting an entire week's curated content warrants a window.confirm() gate naming the week and document count — the first deliberate exception to this feature's established act-immediately-rely-on-rollback pattern, given the blast radius

nodes.label: Rationale: updateLiveQuotes merges fresh live-quote overrides into currentPortfolioEntries but skips re-rendering while currentIsEditing is true, reproducing production's refreshDataUnlessEditing protection against wiping an in-progress, uncommitted keystroke
nodes.norm_label: rationale: updatelivequotes merges fresh live-quote overrides into currentportfolioentries but skips re-rendering while currentisediting is true, reproducing production's refreshdataunlessediting protection against wiping an in-progress, uncommitted keystroke
